## 2. [以往的 PyTorch 版本](https://pytorch.com.tw/get-started/previous-versions)

以往的 PyTorch 版本 PyTorch｡pytorch.org/whl/cu90/torch_stable.html # CUDA 8.0 Download and install wheel from https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu80/torch_stable.html # CPU only Download and install wheel from https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu/torch_stable.html 版本 < 1.0.0 的命令 透過 Conda 這適用於大多數以前的 macOS 版本安裝｡ 要透過 Anaconda 或 Miniconda 安裝舊版本的 PyTorch,請將以下命令中的“0.4.1”替換為您所需的版本(例如“0.2.0”)｡ 安裝 CUDA 9 conda install pytorch=0.4.1 cuda90 -c pytorch 或者 conda install pytorch=0.4.1 cuda92 -c pytorch 安裝 CUDA 8 conda install pytorch=0.4.1 cuda80 -c pytorch 安裝 CUDA 7.5 conda install pytorch=0.4.1 cuda75 -c pytorch 安裝不含 CUDA 的版本 conda install pytorch=0.4.1 -c pytorch 從原始碼安裝 您可以簽出舊版本的 PyTorch 並進行構建｡您可以使用 git tag 列出 PyTorch git 倉庫中的標籤,並使用以下命令簽出特定版本(將“0.1.9”替換為您所需的版本): git checkout v0.1.9 請遵循 PyTorch 倉庫 README.md 中的“從原始碼安裝”說明｡ 透過 Pip 從以下 HTML 頁面下載所需版本的 whl 檔案 https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu/torch_stable.html # 僅 CPU 構建 https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu80/torch_stable.html # CUDA 8.0 構建 https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu90/torch_stable.html # CUDA 9.0 構建 https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu92/torch_stable.html # CUDA 9.2 構建 https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu100/torch_stable.html # CUDA 10.0 構建 然後,使用 pip install [已下載檔案] 進行安裝 注意:大多數 PyTorch 版本僅適用於特定的 CUDA 版本｡例如,pytorch=1.0.1 不支援 CUDA 9.2 (舊版)使用 CUDA 7.5 編譯的 Linux 版 PyTorch 二進位制檔案 這些檔案早於上述 HTML 頁面,必須透過下載 wheel 檔案並使用 pip install downloaded_file 手動安裝｡ cu75/torch-0.3.0.post4-cp36-cp36m-linux_x86_64.whl cu75/torch-0.3.0.post4-cp35-cp35m-linux_x86_64.whl cu75/torch-0.3.0.post4-cp27-cp27mu-linux_x86_64.whl cu75/torch-0.3.0.post4-cp27-cp27m-linux_x86_64.whl cu75/torch-0.2.0.post3-cp36-cp36m-manylinux1_x86_64.whl cu75/torch-0.2.0.post3-cp35-cp35m-manylinux1_x86_64.whl cu75/torch-0.2.0.post3-cp27-cp27mu-manylinux1_x86_64.whl cu75/torch-0.2.0.post3-cp27-cp27m-manylinux1_x86_64.whl cu75/torch-0.2.0.post2-cp36-cp36m-manylinux1_x86_64.whl cu75/torch-0.2.0.post2-cp35-cp35m-manylinux1_x86_64.whl cu75/torch-0.2.0.post2-cp27-cp27mu-manylinux1_x86_64.

## 3. [安装 PyTorch 的历史版本](https://pytorch.ac.cn/get-started/previous-versions)

安装 PyTorch 的历史版本 PyTorch｡pytorch.org/whl/cu90/torch_stable.html# CUDA 8.0Download and install wheel from https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu80/torch_stable.html# CPU onlyDownload and install wheel from https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu/torch_stable.html Copy 版本 < 1.0.0 的命令 通过 conda 这应该用于大多数以前的 macOS 版本安装｡ 要通过 Anaconda 或Miniconda 安装以前版本的 PyTorch,请将以下命令中的 “0.4.1” 替换为所需的版本(例如 “0.2.0”)｡ 使用 CUDA 9 安装 conda install pytorch=0.4.1 cuda90 -c pytorch 或 conda install pytorch=0.4.1 cuda92 -c pytorch 使用 CUDA 8 安装 conda install pytorch=0.4.1 cuda80 -c pytorch 使用 CUDA 7.5 安装 conda install pytorch=0.4.1 cuda75 -c pytorch 不使用 CUDA 安装 conda install pytorch=0.4.1 -c pytorch 从源码编译 您可以检出较旧版本的PyTorch并进行构建｡您可以使用 git tag 列出 PyTorch git 仓库中的标签,并使用以下命令检出特定版本(将‘0.1.9’ 替换为所需的版本): git checkout v0.1.9 请按照 PyTorch 检出目录中 README.md 中的从源码编译说明进行操作｡ 通过 pip 从以下 html 页面下载所需版本的 whl 文件 然后,使用 pip install [下载的文件] 安装该文件 注意:大多数 pytorch 版本仅适用于特定的 CUDA 版本｡例如,pytorch=1.0.1 不适用于 CUDA 9.2 使用 CUDA 7.5 编译的(旧版)PyTorch Linux 二进制文件 这些文件早于上述 html 页面,必须通过下载 wheel 文件并运行 pip install downloaded_file 进行手动安装 Mac 及其他二进制文件 对于最近的 macOS 二进制文件,使用 conda 例如: conda install pytorch=0.4.1 cuda90 -c pytorch conda install pytorch=0.4.1 cuda92 -c pytorch conda install pytorch=0.4.1 cuda80 -c pytorch conda install pytorch=0.4.1 -c pytorch # 无CUDA

## 4. [开始使用](https://pytorch-cn.com/get-started/previous-versions)

开始使用 PyTorch中文社区｡html v1.0.0 Conda OSX # conda conda install pytorch==1.0.0 torchvision==0.2.1 -c pytorch Linux and Windows # CUDA 10.0 conda install pytorch==1.0.0 torchvision==0.2.1 cuda100 -c pytorch # CUDA 9.0 conda install pytorch==1.0.0 torchvision==0.2.1 cuda90 -c pytorch # CUDA 8.0 conda install pytorch==1.0.0 torchvision==0.2.1 cuda80 -c pytorch # CPU Only conda install pytorch-cpu==1.0.0 torchvision-cpu==0.2.1 cpuonly -c pytorch Wheel OSX pip install torch==1.0.0 torchvision==0.2.1 Linux and Windows # CUDA 10.0 Download and install wheel from https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu100/torch_stable.html # CUDA 9.0 Download and install wheel from https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu90/torch_stable.html # CUDA 8.0 Download and install wheel from https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu80/torch_stable.html # CPU only Download and install wheel from https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu/torch_stable.html Commands for Versions < 1.0.0 Via conda This should be used for most previous macOS version installs. To install a previous version of PyTorch via Anaconda or Miniconda, replace “0.4.1” in the following commands with the desired version (i.e., “0.2.0”). Installing with CUDA 9 conda install pytorch=0.4.1 cuda90 -c pytorch or conda install pytorch=0.4.1 cuda92 -c pytorch Installing with CUDA 8 conda install pytorch=0.4.1 cuda80 -c pytorch Installing with CUDA 7.5 conda install pytorch=0.4.1 cuda75 -c pytorch Installing without CUDA conda install pytorch=0.4.1 -c pytorch From source It is possible to checkout an older version of PyTorch and build it. # PyTorch Version → torchvision Version → CUDA Options Mapping

## Summary

The page provides exact `pip install` commands for every PyTorch release. Below is a structured extraction focusing on the **torch / torchvision / CUDA (`cuXXX`)** mappings for recent versions, with commands quoted verbatim. Note that older commands use the `--index-url` flag, while versions ≤ 1.13 were published with an explicit `+cuXXX` local version tag and `--extra-index-url`.

---

## Recent Versions (using `--index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cuXXX`)

### v2.13.0 — torchvision 0.28.0
CUDA options: **cu126, cu130, cu132** (+ rocm7.1, rocm7.2, cpu)
```plaintext
# ROCM 7.1 (Linux only)
pip install torch==2.13.0 torchvision==0.28.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/rocm7.1
# ROCM 7.2 (Linux only)
pip install torch==2.13.0 torchvision==0.28.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/rocm7.2

# CUDA Toolkit Versions and Minimum Required NVIDIA Driver Versions

## Summary

The release notes provide driver version information in two forms: a **driver branch mapping** table (for CUDA 13.x) and an **exact minimum driver version** table (for CUDA 12.9 and earlier). I've extracted both, focusing on CUDA 12.x and 13.x.

---

## CUDA 13.x — Corresponding Driver Branch (Table 2)

| CUDA Toolkit | Corresponding Driver Branch |
|---|---|
| CUDA 13.4 | R615 |
| CUDA 13.3 | R610 |
| CUDA 13.2 | R595 |
| CUDA 13.1 | R590 |
| CUDA 13.0 | R580 |

> **Note:** Existing CUDA 13.x applications run on drivers `>=580` under CUDA minor version compatibility. CUDA 13.4 new features require an R615 or later driver. The Windows driver for the RTX Spark device is **616.41 or later**.

### CUDA 13.x — Minimum Required Driver Version (Minor Version Compatibility, Table 3)

| CTK Version | Driver Range for Minor Version Compatibility |
|---|---|
| 13.x | Min: `>= 580` · Max: N/A |

---

## CUDA 12.x — Corresponding Driver Versions (Table 4)

### CUDA 12.9 through 12.4

| CUDA Toolkit | Linux x86_64 Driver Version | Windows x86_64 Driver Version |
|---|---|---|
| CUDA 12.9 Update 1 | >=575.57.08 | >=576.57 |
| CUDA 12.9 GA | >=575.51.03 | >=576.02 |
| CUDA 12.8 Update 1 | >=570.124.06 | >=572.61 |
| CUDA 12.8 GA | >=570.26 | >=570.65 |
| CUDA 12.6 Update 3 | >=560.35.05 | >=561.17 |
| CUDA 12.6 Update 2 | >=560.35.03 | >=560.94 |
| CUDA 12.6 Update 1 | >=560.35.03 | >=560.94 |
| CUDA 12.6 GA | >=560.28.03 | >=560.76 |
| CUDA 12.5 Update 1 | >=555.42.06 | >=555.85 |
| CUDA 12.5 GA | >=555.42.02 | >=555.85 |
| CUDA 12.4 Update 1 | >=550.54.15 | >=551.78 |
| CUDA 12.4 GA | >=550.54.14 | >=551.61 |

### CUDA 12.3 through 12.0

| CUDA Toolkit | Linux x86_64 Driver Version | Windows x86_64 Driver Version |
|---|---|---|
| CUDA 12.3 Update 1 | >=545.23.08 | >=546.12 |
| CUDA 12.3 GA | >=545.23.06 | >=545.84 |
| CUDA 12.2 Update 2 | >=535.104.05 | >=537.13 |
| CUDA 12.2 Update 1 | >=535.86.09 | >=536.67 |
| CUDA 12.2 GA | >=535.54.03 | >=536.25 |
| CUDA 12.1 Update 1 | >=530.30.02 | >=531.14 |
| CUDA 12.1 GA | >=530.30.02 | >=531.14 |
| CUDA 12.0 Update 1 | >=525.85.12 | >=528.33 |
| CUDA 12.0 GA | >=525.60.13 | >=527.41 |

### CUDA 12.x — Minor Version Compatibility Range (Table 3)

| CTK Version | Driver Range for Minor Version Compatibility |
|---|---|
| 12.x | Min: `>= 525` · Max: `< 580` |

---

## Key Points

- **Driver branch naming:** CUDA 13.x uses branch identifiers (R580 → R615), while CUDA 12.x and earlier are specified with exact minimum version numbers (e.g., `>=575.57.08`).
- **Backward compatibility:** Existing CUDA 13.x applications run on drivers `>=580` under minor version compatibility.
- **Windows-specific note:** For CUDA 13.4, the Windows driver for the RTX Spark device must be **616.41 or later**.
- **Important change:** The NVIDIA driver is **no longer bundled** with the CUDA Toolkit — on Windows starting with CUDA 13.1, and on Linux starting with CUDA 13.4. Drivers must be downloaded separately from the NVIDIA Driver Downloads page.
- **Update releases** within a CUDA minor version use the **same driver branch**.

# torch.cuda#

# torch.cuda#
Created On: Dec 23, 2016 | Last Updated On: Aug 08, 2026

This package adds support for CUDA tensor types.

It implements the same function as CPU tensors, but they utilize GPUs for computation.

It is lazily initialized, so you can always import it, and use `is_available()` to determine if your system supports CUDA.

CUDA semantics has more details about working with CUDA.

`check_error`

`current_solver_handle`

`current_device`

## Memory management#

# torch.cuda#
## Memory management#
- **pool** (*torch.cuda.MemPool*) – a MemPool object to be made active so that allocations route to this pool.
- **device** (*torch.device* *or* *int*")*, optional*) – selected device. Uses MemPool on the current device, given by `current_device()`, if `device` is `None` (default).

Note

This context manager makes only current thread’s allocations route to the given pool. If a new thread is spawned inside the context manager (e.g. by calling backward) the allocations in that thread will not route to the given pool.

Note

When used during `CUDAGraph` capture, the graph retains the pool until the graph is reset or destroyed.

Returns the version of the NCCL.

This function returns a tuple containing the major, minor, and patch version numbers of the NCCL. The suffix is also included in the tuple if a version suffix exists. :returns: The version information of the NCCL. :rtype: tuple

## Green Contexts (experimental)#

# torch.cuda#
## Green Contexts (experimental)#
`torch.cuda.green_contexts` provides thin wrappers around the CUDA Green Context APIs to enable more general carveout of SM resources for CUDA kernels.

These APIs require the `cuda.bindings` package and can be used in PyTorch with CUDA versions greater than or equal to 12.8. Workqueue configuration requires CUDA 13.1 or newer.

Install instructions for `cuda.bindings` can be found here: https://nvidia.github.io/cuda-python/

Create streams from the green context and use them like other custom CUDA streams:

```
ctx = GreenContext(...)
stream = ctx.Stream()
with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
    # torch operations here are using resources from `ctx`
    pass
```

Synchronization between green-context streams and other streams is the user’s responsibility. Use CUDA events to order work, just as you would for any other custom stream.

The `GreenContext.set_context()` and `GreenContext.pop_context()` methods are deprecated compatibility APIs.

`GreenContext`

Wrapper around a CUDA green context.

# torch.cuda#

# torch.cuda#
Created On: Dec 23, 2016 | Last Updated On: Aug 08, 2026

This package adds support for CUDA tensor types.

It implements the same function as CPU tensors, but they utilize GPUs for computation.

It is lazily initialized, so you can always import it, and use `is_available()` to determine if your system supports CUDA.

CUDA semantics has more details about working with CUDA.

`StreamContext`

Context-manager that selects a given stream.

`can_device_access_peer`

Check if peer access between two devices is possible.

`check_error`

Raise an error if the result of a CUDA runtime API call is not success.

`current_blas_handle`

Return cublasHandle_t pointer to current cuBLAS handle

`current_solver_handle`

Return cusolverDnHandle_t pointer to current cuSOLVER handle

`current_device`

Return the index of a currently selected device.

# torch.cuda#
`current_stream`

Return the currently selected `Stream` for a given device.

`cudart`

Retrieves the CUDA runtime API module.

`default_stream`

Return the default `Stream` for a given device.

`device`

Context-manager that changes the selected device.

`device_count`

Return the number of GPUs available.

`device_memory_used`

Return used global (device) memory in bytes as given by nvidia-smi or amd-smi.

`device_of`

Context-manager that changes the current device to that of given object.

`get_arch_list`

Return list CUDA architectures this library was compiled for.

# torch.cuda#
`get_device_capability`

Get the cuda capability of a device.

`get_device_name`

Get the name of a device.

`get_device_properties`

Get the properties of a device.

`get_gencode_flags`

Return NVCC gencode flags this library was compiled with.

`get_stream_from_external`

Return a `Stream` from an externally allocated CUDA stream.

`get_sync_debug_mode`

Return current value of debug mode for cuda synchronizing operations.

`init`

Initialize PyTorch's CUDA state.

`ipc_collect`

Force collects GPU memory after it has been released by CUDA IPC.

`is_available`

# torch.cuda#
Return a bool indicating if CUDA is currently available.

`is_bf16_supported`

Return a bool indicating if the current CUDA/ROCm device supports dtype bfloat16.

`is_initialized`

Return whether PyTorch's CUDA state has been initialized.

`is_tf32_supported`

Return a bool indicating if the current CUDA/ROCm device supports dtype tf32.

`memory_usage`

Return the percent of time over the past sample period during which global (device) memory was being read or written as given by nvidia-smi.

`set_device`

Set the current device.

`set_stream`

Set the current stream. This is a wrapper API to set the stream.

`set_sync_debug_mode`

Set the debug mode for cuda synchronizing operations.

`stream`

Wrap around the Context-manager StreamContext that selects a given stream.

[...]

## Memory management#

# torch.cuda#
## Memory management#
- **pool** (*torch.cuda.MemPool*) – a MemPool object to be made active so that allocations route to this pool.
- **device** (*torch.device* *or* *int*")*, optional*) – selected device. Uses MemPool on the current device, given by `current_device()`, if `device` is `None` (default).

Note

This context manager makes only current thread’s allocations route to the given pool. If a new thread is spawned inside the context manager (e.g. by calling backward) the allocations in that thread will not route to the given pool.

Note

When used during `CUDAGraph` capture, the graph retains the pool until the graph is reset or destroyed.

torch.cuda.nccl.version()[[source]](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/v2.14.0/torch/cuda/nccl.py#L35)#

Returns the version of the NCCL.

This function returns a tuple containing the major, minor, and patch version numbers of the NCCL. The suffix is also included in the tuple if a version suffix exists. :returns: The version information of the NCCL. :rtype: tuple

`profile`

Enable profiling.

[...]

## Stream Sanitizer (prototype)#

CUDA Sanitizer is a prototype tool for detecting synchronization errors between streams in PyTorch. See the documentation for information on how to use it.

[...]

## Green Contexts (experimental)#

# torch.cuda#
## Green Contexts (experimental)#
`torch.cuda.green_contexts` provides thin wrappers around the CUDA Green Context APIs to enable more general carveout of SM resources for CUDA kernels.

These APIs require the `cuda.bindings` package and can be used in PyTorch with CUDA versions greater than or equal to 12.8. Workqueue configuration requires CUDA 13.1 or newer.

Install instructions for `cuda.bindings` can be found here: https://nvidia.github.io/cuda-python/

Create streams from the green context and use them like other custom CUDA streams:

```
ctx = GreenContext(...)
stream = ctx.Stream()
with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
    # torch operations here are using resources from `ctx`
    pass
```

Synchronization between green-context streams and other streams is the user’s responsibility. Use CUDA events to order work, just as you would for any other custom stream.

The `GreenContext.set_context()` and `GreenContext.pop_context()` methods are deprecated compatibility APIs.

`GreenContext`

Wrapper around a CUDA green context.

torch.cuda.nccl.is_available(*tensors*)[[source]](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/v2.14.0/torch/cuda/nccl.py#L14)#

This package adds support for NVIDIA Tools Extension (NVTX) used in profiling.

**标题**: CUDA Compatibility — CUDA Compatibility

Back to top

# CUDA Compatibility[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/latest/#cuda-compatibility "Link to this heading")

[CUDA Compatibility](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/) describes how CUDA applications and toolkit components can run across different NVIDIA driver versions. It enables greater flexibility when upgrading CUDA toolkits and applications by reducing the need to upgrade drivers at the same time in every deployment scenario.

This flexibility is important for data center, enterprise, and managed environments, where driver updates may follow different qualification or maintenance schedules than application and toolkit updates. CUDA Compatibility helps bridge that gap by defining supported ways to run newer CUDA software on existing driver installations, within documented limits.

CUDA Compatibility includes [Minor Version Compatibility](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/minor-version-compatibility.html), available starting with CUDA 11, which allows applications built within the same major CUDA release family to run on a sufficiently new driver, with some feature limitations.

It also includes [Forward Compatibility](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/forward-compatibility.html), which uses the `cuda-compat-<major>-<minor>` package to allow applications built with a newer toolkit to run on older base drivers across major release families, subject to platform and GPU support.

This guide introduces these compatibility models, outlines the supported upgrade paths, and helps developers and administrators determine which approach is appropriate for their platform, driver, GPU, and CUDA toolkit combination.

# CUDA Compatibility[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/latest/#cuda-compatibility "Link to this heading")

[CUDA Compatibility](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/) describes how CUDA applications and toolkit components can run across different NVIDIA driver versions. It enables greater flexibility when upgrading CUDA toolkits and applications by reducing the need to upgrade drivers at the same time in every deployment scenario.

This flexibility is important for data center, enterprise, and managed environments, where driver updates may follow different qualification or maintenance schedules than application and toolkit updates. CUDA Compatibility helps bridge that gap by defining supported ways to run newer CUDA software on existing driver installations, within documented limits.

CUDA Compatibility includes [Minor Version Compatibility](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/minor-version-compatibility.html), available starting with CUDA 11, which allows applications built within the same major CUDA release family to run on a sufficiently new driver, with some feature limitations.

It also includes [Forward Compatibility](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/forward-compatibility.html), which uses the `cuda-compat-<major>-<minor>` package to allow applications built with a newer toolkit to run on older base drivers across major release families, subject to platform and GPU support.

This guide introduces these compatibility models, outlines the supported upgrade paths, and helps developers and administrators determine which approach is appropriate for their platform, driver, GPU, and CUDA toolkit combination.

# PyTorch / CUDA toolkit / cuDNN / 驱动 版本配套关系查询方法

## 一、先理解"四层依赖链"的方向

这四者不是简单平级，而是逐层锚定：

1. **驱动（NVIDIA Driver）是最底层**：向上决定"本机最高能跑哪个 CUDA 运行时大版本"。驱动向下兼容——新驱动能跑旧 CUDA，但旧驱动跑不了过新的 CUDA 新特性。
2. **CUDA toolkit / runtime**：官方为每个 toolkit 版本规定了**最低驱动版本**（见 NVIDIA CUDA Release Notes 表）。
3. **PyTorch 是预编译 wheel**：每个 wheel 针对**某一个固定 CUDA 版本**编译（`cu118` / `cu121` / `cu124` / `cu126` / `cu128` / `cu130` / `cu132`）。所以"PyTorch↔CUDA toolkit"的关系不是随便配，而是**用哪个 `--index-url` 装哪个 wheel 就绑定了哪个 CUDA 版本**。
4. **cuDNN**：是 CUDA 之上的库，每个 cuDNN 版本对应一组 CUDA 版本（+最低驱动），由官方 support matrix 给出。

关键认知：PyTorch wheel 通常**自带 CUDA runtime 库**，所以本机 `nvcc`/`/usr/local/cuda` 的版本（开发用 toolkit）**不一定**等于 PyTorch 实际运行用的 CUDA 版本。二者要分开查。

## 二、三层官方"查表入口"

| 要查的关系 | 官方页面 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| PyTorch ↔ CUDA | [Previous PyTorch Versions](https://pytorch.org/get-started/previous-versions/)（及 [Get Started Locally](https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/)） | 每个 torch 版本列出可选的 `cuXXX` index-url |
| CUDA ↔ 驱动 | [CUDA Toolkit Release Notes → "CUDA Toolkit and Corresponding Driver Versions"](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-toolkit-release-notes/index.html) | 每个 toolkit 版本的最低驱动（Linux/Windows 分开） |
| cuDNN ↔ CUDA ↔ 驱动 | [cuDNN Support Matrix](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/latest/reference/support-matrix.html) | cuDNN 包 → CUDA 版本 → 最低驱动 → GPU 架构 |
| 兼容性规则（minor/forward） | [CUDA Compatibility](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/) | minor version compatibility、forward compatibility（`cuda-compat-*`） |

## 三、本机版本核查命令（逐条照抄可运行）

**1) 驱动版本 + 驱动支持的 CUDA 运行时上限：**
```bash
nvidia-smi
```
看右上角 `Driver Version: xxx.xx` 与 `CUDA Version: yy.y`。
注意：`nvidia-smi` 里的 **CUDA Version 是驱动能支持的最高 runtime 版本，不是已安装的 toolkit 版本**，常见误读点。

**2) 本机 CUDA toolkit（开发用）版本：**
```bash
nvcc --version
# 或
cat /usr/local/cuda/version.json
# 或
ls -l /usr/local | grep cuda
```

**3) 本机 cuDNN 版本：**
```bash
cat /usr/local/cuda/include/cudnn_version.h | grep CUDNN_MAJOR -A 2
```

**4) PyTorch 实际绑定的 CUDA / cuDNN / 编译目标（最重要，直接看 wheel 的真相）：**
```bash
python -c "import torch; print('torch', torch.__version__); print('torch cuda', torch.version.cuda); print('cudnn', torch.backends.cudnn.version()); print('avail', torch.cuda.is_available()); print('arch list', torch.cuda.get_arch_list())"
```
其中 `torch.version.cuda` 是 PyTorch 编译所用 CUDA 版本；`torch.backends.cudnn.version()` 返回 cuDNN 版本（官方文档 torch.backends.cudnn 明确：`torch.backends.cudnn.version()` = "Return the version of cuDNN"）。`torch.cuda.get_arch_list()` 返回该 wheel 编译支持的 compute capability 列表。

**5) 从包元数据侧面确认：**
```bash
pip show torch
```

## 四、对照查表（本文检索到的官方数值，2026-09）

### 4.1 PyTorch → 可安装 CUDA 版本（官方 previous-versions 页）

| PyTorch | torchvision | 可选 `cuXXX` |
|---|---|---|
| 2.13.0 | 0.28.0 | cu126, cu130, cu132 |
| 2.12.x | 0.27.x | cu126, cu130, cu132 |
| 2.11.0 | 0.26.0 | cu126, cu128, cu130 |
| 2.10.0 | 0.25.0 | cu126, cu128, cu130 |
| 2.9.x | 0.24.x | cu126, cu128, cu130 |
| 2.8.0 | 0.23.0 | cu126, cu128, cu129 |
| 2.7.x | 0.22.x | cu118, cu126, cu128 |
| 2.6.0 | 0.21.0 | cu118, cu124, cu126 |
| 2.5.x | 0.20.x | cu118, cu121, cu124 |
| 2.4.x | 0.19.x | cu118, cu121, cu124 |
| 2.3.x | 0.18.x | cu118, cu121 |
| 2.0–2.2 | 0.15–0.17 | cu118（部分含 cu121） |

安装示例（官方原文，注意 `--index-url` 与 `+cuXXX` 两种写法）：
```bash
# 新版（>=2.0 风格）
pip install torch==2.13.0 torchvision==0.28.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu126
# 旧版（1.x 风格，版本里带 +cuXXX，用 --extra-index-url）
pip install torch==1.13.1+cu117 torchvision==0.14.1+cu117 torchaudio==0.13.1 \
  --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu117
```

### 4.2 CUDA toolkit → 最低驱动版本（官方 CUDA Release Notes）

CUDA 12.x（Linux x86_64 / Windows）：
| CUDA | Linux 最低驱动 | Windows 最低驱动 |
|---|---|---|
| 12.9 Update 1 | >=575.57.08 | >=576.57 |
| 12.9 GA | >=575.51.03 | >=576.02 |
| 12.8 Update 1 | >=570.124.06 | >=572.61 |
| 12.8 GA | >=570.26 | >=570.65 |
| 12.6 GA | >=560.28.03 | >=560.76 |
| 12.5 GA | >=555.42.02 | >=555.85 |
| 12.4 GA | >=550.54.14 | >=551.61 |
| 12.3 GA | >=545.23.06 | >=545.84 |
| 12.2 GA | >=535.54.03 | >=536.25 |
| 12.1 GA | >=530.30.02 | >=531.14 |
| 12.0 GA | >=525.60.13 | >=527.41 |

CUDA 13.x（按驱动分支 R 系列）：
| CUDA | 对应驱动分支 |
|---|---|
| 13.4 | R615 |
| 13.3 | R610 |
| 13.2 | R595 |
| 13.1 | R590 |
| 13.0 | R580 |

兼容规则（官方原文要点）：
- **Minor Version Compatibility**：CUDA 12.x 应用可在驱动 `>=525` 且 `<580` 上运行；CUDA 13.x 应用可在 `>=580` 上运行（同大版本内，用较旧驱动跑较新 minor，有限制）。
- **Forward Compatibility**：用 `cuda-compat-<major>-<minor>` 包让新 toolkit 应用在旧 base driver 上跑，需平台/GPU 支持。
- 注意：CUDA 13.1（Windows）/ 13.4（Linux）起，**驱动不再随 toolkit 捆绑**，需单独安装。

### 4.3 cuDNN → CUDA（官方 cuDNN Support Matrix）

- **cuDNN 9.26.0 for CUDA 12.x**：支持 CUDA 12.0–12.9；Linux 驱动 `>=525.60.13`，Windows `>=527.41`。
- **cuDNN 9.26.0 for CUDA 13.x**：支持 CUDA 13.0–13.4；Linux 驱动 `>=615.71.09`（Windows 该行显示 N/A）。
- 脚注：CUDA 12.x 的动态库构建兼容所有未来 CUDA 12.x；部分架构（Blackwell 等）需 CUDA `>=12.8`、Linux 驱动 `>=570.26`；CUDA 13.4 需 Linux 驱动 `>=615.71.09`。
- 官方推荐配置：cuDNN 9.26.0 + CUDA 13.4。

## 五、实操判断流程（把"对不上"修好）

1. `nvidia-smi` 取驱动版本 → 定出**驱动允许的最高 CUDA 大版本**。
2. 在 4.1 表中选一个 `cuXXX`，使该 CUDA 版本 ≤ 驱动支持上限（用 4.2 表核对最低驱动）。
3. 用对应 `--index-url` 重装 PyTorch（务必 torch/torchvision/torchaudio 版本一致，且**先卸载**旧 torch 再装，避免残留）。
4. 用第三节的 `python -c ...` 命令确认 `torch.version.cuda` 与 `torch.backends.cudnn.version()` 与预期一致。
5. 如果是"源码编译"场景，才需要本机 toolkit/cuDNN 版本与 PyTorch 源码要求匹配（此时查 PyTorch 仓库 README 的 build 要求）。

典型"对不上"根因：`nvidia-smi` 的 CUDA Version 被误当成 toolkit 版本；或 conda/pip 混装、`pytorch-cuda` 与 `cudatoolkit` 不一致；或驱动过旧但装了新 `cuXXX` wheel。

# PyTorch / CUDA toolkit / cuDNN / 驱动 版本配套关系查询方法

## 一、先理解"四层依赖链"的方向

这四者不是简单平级，而是逐层锚定：

1. **驱动（NVIDIA Driver）是最底层**：向上决定"本机最高能跑哪个 CUDA 运行时大版本"。驱动向下兼容——新驱动能跑旧 CUDA，但旧驱动跑不了过新的 CUDA 新特性。
2. **CUDA toolkit / runtime**：官方为每个 toolkit 版本规定了**最低驱动版本**（见 NVIDIA CUDA Release Notes 表）。
3. **PyTorch 是预编译 wheel**：每个 wheel 针对**某一个固定 CUDA 版本**编译（`cu118` / `cu121` / `cu124` / `cu126` / `cu128` / `cu130` / `cu132`）。所以"PyTorch↔CUDA toolkit"的关系不是随便配，而是**用哪个 `--index-url` 装哪个 wheel 就绑定了哪个 CUDA 版本**。
4. **cuDNN**：是 CUDA 之上的库，每个 cuDNN 版本对应一组 CUDA 版本（+最低驱动），由官方 support matrix 给出。

关键认知：PyTorch wheel 通常**自带 CUDA runtime 库**，所以本机 `nvcc`/`/usr/local/cuda` 的版本（开发用 toolkit）**不一定**等于 PyTorch 实际运行用的 CUDA 版本。二者要分开查。

## 二、三层官方"查表入口"

| 要查的关系 | 官方页面 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| PyTorch ↔ CUDA | [Previous PyTorch Versions](https://pytorch.org/get-started/previous-versions/)（及 [Get Started Locally](https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/)） | 每个 torch 版本列出可选的 `cuXXX` index-url |
| CUDA ↔ 驱动 | [CUDA Toolkit Release Notes → "CUDA Toolkit and Corresponding Driver Versions"](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-toolkit-release-notes/index.html) | 每个 toolkit 版本的最低驱动（Linux/Windows 分开） |
| cuDNN ↔ CUDA ↔ 驱动 | [cuDNN Support Matrix](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/latest/reference/support-matrix.html) | cuDNN 包 → CUDA 版本 → 最低驱动 → GPU 架构 |
| 兼容性规则（minor/forward） | [CUDA Compatibility](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/) | minor version compatibility、forward compatibility（`cuda-compat-*`） |

## 三、本机版本核查命令（逐条照抄可运行）

**1) 驱动版本 + 驱动支持的 CUDA 运行时上限：**
```bash
nvidia-smi
```
看右上角 `Driver Version: xxx.xx` 与 `CUDA Version: yy.y`。
注意：`nvidia-smi` 里的 **CUDA Version 是驱动能支持的最高 runtime 版本，不是已安装的 toolkit 版本**，常见误读点。

**2) 本机 CUDA toolkit（开发用）版本：**
```bash
nvcc --version
# 或
cat /usr/local/cuda/version.json
# 或
ls -l /usr/local | grep cuda
```

**3) 本机 cuDNN 版本：**
```bash
cat /usr/local/cuda/include/cudnn_version.h | grep CUDNN_MAJOR -A 2
```

**4) PyTorch 实际绑定的 CUDA / cuDNN / 编译目标（最重要，直接看 wheel 的真相）：**
```bash
python -c "import torch; print('torch', torch.__version__); print('torch cuda', torch.version.cuda); print('cudnn', torch.backends.cudnn.version()); print('avail', torch.cuda.is_available()); print('arch list', torch.cuda.get_arch_list())"
```
其中 `torch.version.cuda` 是 PyTorch 编译所用 CUDA 版本；`torch.backends.cudnn.version()` 返回 cuDNN 版本（官方文档 torch.backends.cudnn 明确：`torch.backends.cudnn.version()` = "Return the version of cuDNN"）。`torch.cuda.get_arch_list()` 返回该 wheel 编译支持的 compute capability 列表。

| 12.2 GA | >=535.54.03 | >=536.25 |

| 2.0–2.2 | 0.15–0.17 | cu118（部分含 cu121） |

安装示例（官方原文，注意 `--index-url` 与 `+cuXXX` 两种写法）：
```bash
# 新版（>=2.0 风格）
pip install torch==2.13.0 torchvision==0.28.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu126
# 旧版（1.x 风格，版本里带 +cuXXX，用 --extra-index-url）
pip install torch==1.13.1+cu117 torchvision==0.14.1+cu117 torchaudio==0.13.1 \
  --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu117
```

CUDA 13.x（按驱动分支 R 系列）：
| CUDA | 对应驱动分支 |
|---|---|
| 13.4 | R615 |
| 13.3 | R610 |

兼容规则（官方原文要点）：
- **Minor Version Compatibility**：CUDA 12.x 应用可在驱动 `>=525` 且 `<580` 上运行；CUDA 13.x 应用可在 `>=580` 上运行（同大版本内，用较旧驱动跑较新 minor，有限制）。
- **Forward Compatibility**：用 `cuda-compat-<major>-<minor>` 包让新 toolkit 应用在旧 base driver 上跑，需平台/GPU 支持。
- 注意：CUDA 13.1（Windows）/ 13.4（Linux）起，**驱动不再随 toolkit 捆绑**，需单独安装。

### 4.3 cuDNN → CUDA（官方 cuDNN Support Matrix）

- **cuDNN 9.26.0 for CUDA 12.x**：支持 CUDA 12.0–12.9；Linux 驱动 `>=525.60.13`，Windows `>=527.41`。
- **cuDNN 9.26.0 for CUDA 13.x**：支持 CUDA 13.0–13.4；Linux 驱动 `>=615.71.09`（Windows 该行显示 N/A）。
- 脚注：CUDA 12.x 的动态库构建兼容所有未来 CUDA 12.x；部分架构（Blackwell 等）需 CUDA `>=12.8`、Linux 驱动 `>=570.26`；CUDA 13.4 需 Linux 驱动 `>=615.71.09`。
- 官方推荐配置：cuDNN 9.26.0 + CUDA 13.4。

## 五、实操判断流程（把"对不上"修好）

1. `nvidia-smi` 取驱动版本 → 定出**驱动允许的最高 CUDA 大版本**。
2. 在 4.1 表中选一个 `cuXXX`，使该 CUDA 版本 ≤ 驱动支持上限（用 4.2 表核对最低驱动）。
3. 用对应 `--index-url` 重装 PyTorch（务必 torch/torchvision/torchaudio 版本一致，且**先卸载**旧 torch 再装，避免残留）。
4. 用第三节的 `python -c ...` 命令确认 `torch.version.cuda` 与 `torch.backends.cudnn.version()` 与预期一致。
5. 如果是"源码编译"场景，才需要本机 toolkit/cuDNN 版本与 PyTorch 源码要求匹配（此时查 PyTorch 仓库 README 的 build 要求）。

典型"对不上"根因：`nvidia-smi` 的 CUDA Version 被误当成 toolkit 版本；或 conda/pip 混装、`pytorch-cuda` 与 `cudatoolkit` 不一致；或驱动过旧但装了新 `cuXXX` wheel。
